author: FishingAngler
quote: This game is missing the secret sauce that made GTA a free for all game, where you could go wild and the game rewarded you with fun gameplay. GTA6 appears to have been turned into a semi-dating game with boring tasks that feel like a fever dream. Waited 13 years for a game with too many bugs and not enough violence and chaos which used to be a staple of GTA. Couldn’t get a refund so here is my honest review, do not waste your money or time on this girlfriend’s chores simulators.
